school.school_name: 尚美ミュージックカレッジ専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Prefer the latest public target-form PDF when a current-year school page exposes a historical list of confirmation application forms.
search_queries: 尚美ミュージックカレッジ専門学校 2026年度 修学支援 様式第2号
尚美ミュージックカレッジ専門学校 令和7年度申請書 様式第2号
steps: Start from the Tokyo official-index matched school URL https://www.shobi.ac.jp/.
Follow the site's public information / support-system page to https://www.shobi.ac.jp/about/info/.
Find the historical confirmation-form list from 令和元年度申請書-様式第2号 through 令和7年度申請書-様式第2号.
Select the latest public target-form candidate r7_syugakushien_shinsei_2.pdf rather than older R1-R6 forms.
Open the linked PDF and verify that its body contains 尚美ミュージックカレッジ専門学校 and 様式第２号.
Keep it as FY2025 publication-lag evidence for FY2026 because the link and PDF do not provide strict 令和8年度 / 2026年度 target-year evidence.

reusable_rules: When a support page lists multiple historical target-form PDFs, scan stale target-form candidates in newest-fiscal-year order after current-year candidates.
Treat the latest public 様式第2号 / 確認申請書 PDF as operator-reviewable publication-lag evidence when it lacks strict target-FY evidence.
Keep generic current-year page wording separate from strict PDF/link target-year evidence unless the local PDF anchor or body proves the target fiscal year.
anti_patterns: Do not download R1/R2-era target-form PDFs before the latest public R7 form merely because the page lists old forms first.
Do not upgrade a latest-public stale form to strict FY2026 success when the PDF body and link label only prove FY2025.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-13 found the Tokyo official-index matched homepage and the school's public information page. Source-side discovery ranked r7_syugakushien_shinsei_2.pdf as the best target-form candidate after scoring; source-side PDF text extraction verified 尚美ミュージックカレッジ専門学校 and 様式第２号 in the PDF body. Strict download rejects it for FY2026 with fiscal_year_mismatch:2025, so this entry preserves newest-public stale target-form ordering without counting it as current-FY success.
